intendedUse: Normalize a current Jersey unit postcode, preserve truthful point, non-area or no-coordinate semantics, retrieve only a competent rights-cleared real Polygon/MultiPolygon corresponding to the unit postcode or a separately labelled broader postal context, fit the map and show a translucent surface with source, reference date, classification and confidence.
recordGrain: one live JE unit-postcode assignment and its exact source-defined surface or honest point/non-area/unavailable reason, plus any separately governed outward-code, sector or district postal context

m2Definition.definition: A current rights-cleared nationwide Jersey unit-postcode denominator and an authoritative or rights-cleared real Polygon/MultiPolygon explicitly corresponding to every searchable geographic unit postcode, or an honest source-defined non-area classification plus a separately labelled real outward-code, sector or district postal-context surface, are pinned by edition, effective date, terms, attribution, CRS, topology, coverage, exceptions and SHA-256 and published as an approved immutable artifact. Searching a normalized JE postcode through the real AGID API/app must preserve unit versus broader-context grain, fit and render only the eligible surface with translucent fill and a clear outline, and show selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date, confidence and any non-area reason. ONSPD GRIDIND 9 placeholders, null geometry, 99.999999 or rounded 100 latitude, longitude 0, JSearch points, addresses, routes, PO boxes, organisations, parishes, administrative areas, buffers, Voronoi cells, parcels/buildings and synthetic fixtures never satisfy M2.

officialObservations.finding: The official page exposes an interactive Jersey address and postcode finder. It warns that upcoming or unbuilt properties may be absent and that database updates may take two months. No address query, row extraction or crawl was performed, and the public page supplies no bulk API, redistribution grant or postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon.

The current website terms page links Jersey Post service terms but does not establish bulk postcode-data, derivative-database, public lookup API or area-geometry redistribution rights for AGID. No contract or licence expansion was accepted.

The Government of Jersey says information hosted on opendata.gov.je is reusable under OGL-J with attribution and exclusions. That item-scoped statement does not automatically license an uncatalogued roadworks.gov.je ArcGIS service whose own licence and access fields are blank.

The official CKAN API returned success with zero postcode datasets. This is a dated catalogue result, not proof that no private or future source can exist, but it supplies no current catalogued postal polygon or reusable assignment release.

The public government search layer is point-only and has blank copyright, licence and access-information fields. Its 1,914 points are incomplete and stale against the May 2026 live ONSPD denominator: 1,891 overlap live codes, 19 overlap terminated codes, four match neither set, one value is format-invalid and 1,324 live ONSPD codes are absent. It is neither a complete assignment denominator nor a rights-cleared area release.
The public ONS item identifies the May 2026 online postcode-centroid service and points to ONS licensing. It does not assert postcode surfaces.
The latest ONSPD layer is explicitly point geometry and caps a page at 2,000 records. Even valid point features would not satisfy the Polygon/MultiPolygon gate.

The complete JE query returned 3,674 distinct format-valid codes: 3,215 live and 459 terminated. Every row has GRIDIND 9, null easting/northing and online-service LAT 100/LONG 0 sentinels. The explicit geometry sample returned no geometry.

The guide includes the Channel Islands and says no geographic coordinates are provided for Channel Islands postcodes. Jersey has 5 districts, 29 sectors, 3,215 live and 459 terminated codes in the May 2026 directory. GRIDIND/PQI 9 means no grid reference. The specification uses latitude 99.999999 and longitude 0 sentinels; the online service rounds latitude to 100.

ONS postcode products excluding Northern Ireland BT data are reusable under OGL v3 with the stated ONS, Ordnance Survey and Royal Mail attributions. Jersey is outside the BT exception. Reuse permission does not supply coordinates or polygon geometry absent from the source.

onspdAudit.reproduction: Query the official May 2026 FeatureServer with the pinned where/outFields, orderByFields=OBJECTID and resultRecordCount=2000 at offsets 0 and 2000. Concatenate features, require 3,674 unique PCDS values, classify blank DOTERM as live, validate ^JE\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$, group live outward strings, and count null coordinates, GRIDIND and sentinel LAT/LONG. Query a geometry sample with returnGeometry=true. Do not promote raw rows or sentinel values.

jsearchAudit.reproduction: Read ET_ID, ET_X and ET_Y from all 1,914 pinned JSearch features, require unique ET_ID values, validate the JE display grammar, group duplicate coordinates, and compare ET_ID exactly against the pinned May 2026 live and terminated ONSPD PCDS sets. This comparison is a quality audit only and does not authorize reuse.

dataQuality.risk: The reusable ONSPD denominator is current and format-valid but intentionally coordinate-less for Jersey. The government JSearch service is point-only, incomplete, stale relative to ONSPD and lacks an explicit licence/access grant. Neither source can support a truthful production postcode area.

browserReview.reason: No production-eligible real JE Polygon/MultiPolygon exists to serve through the country route. Shared deterministic UI tests verify the fail-closed area capability without presenting ONSPD sentinels, JSearch points or synthetic cells as JE evidence.

pdfReview.limitation: Poppler rendered the requested PNGs, but the local image inspection tool returned Windows os error 206 even for C:\tmp files. Extracted text, metadata, query totals and file digests were reconciled; no claim of successful visual inspection is made.

visualizationDecision.reason: The authority, rights, currentness and geometry audit matrix is clearer than a chart for this binary M2 gate, and no truthful spatial surface exists to map.

blockerSummary: The May 2026 ONSPD provides a reusable current Jersey denominator of 3,215 live unit postcodes, but all 3,674 live and terminated JE rows have GRIDIND 9, null eastings/northings, 100/0 coordinate sentinels and no geometry. The official guide confirms that Channel Islands postcodes receive no geographic coordinates. Government JSearch exposes only 1,914 incomplete/stale points, no polygons and no explicit licence/access grant; Jersey Post exposes an interactive finder but no reviewed bulk/public-serving or geometry grant. No rights-cleared real unit-postcode or broader postal-context Polygon/MultiPolygon, immutable area artifact or real AGID area path exists.
unblockConditions: Obtain a current rights-cleared nationwide JE unit-postcode assignment denominator with edition, effective date, update cadence, terms, required attributions, coverage, exceptions, byte length and SHA-256; preserve source-defined non-geographic, large-user, PO-box, route and organisation classifications.

Obtain an authoritative or rights-cleared real Polygon/MultiPolygon explicitly corresponding to each searchable geographic unit postcode, or an honest unit non-area classification plus a complete separately labelled outward-code, sector or district postal-context release with deterministic unit membership, CRS, topology, validity, terms, attribution, coverage, exceptions and SHA-256. Do not substitute sentinels, JSearch points, parishes, administration, buffers, Voronoi cells, parcels or buildings.
Publish an approved immutable artifact without private addresses, personal, customer, building, cadastral or land-right data and preserve exact-unit versus broader postal-context grain.
Pass real JE normalization, loader, API, point/non-area or unavailable reason, Polygon/MultiPolygon validation, fit, translucent fill, outline, provenance, clear and re-search verification.
